newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Malaysia-Anwar sees no immediate need for ratecut.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia-Anwar sees no immediate need for ratecut.

text.p: Malaysia's Minister of Finance and Deputy Prime Minister Anwar bin Ibrahim said on Friday in Hong Kong he saw no immediate need to reduce interest rates to spur the economy.

"I don't see any need for an immediate move on the economy including cutting rates," Anwar, who was attending an IMF-Hong Kong Monetary Authority Conference on financial integration in Asia and the role of Hong Kong, told reporters.
"We are quite happy with the results of the latest figures on economic growth and the figure on the current account deficit."
